scenario.summary: Opens the Quick Order Pad, checks the tabs and default quantity, selects a product from the SKU auto-suggestion, checks Add to Cart becomes enabled, types a quantity above the product's maximum and checks the range message.
steps: Open the webstore, Quick Order, Add Multiple Items
Verify pad heading; open Paste Multiple; verify default quantity
Verify Search / Paste Multiple tab labels
Select validSku from the auto-suggestion in row 1; verify Add to Cart enabled
Set quantity aboveMaximumQuantity; verify the SKU validation message
assertions: Add to Cart disabled, then enabled
Validation message equals 'Selected quantity should be in between 1 to 100'
evidence: First method of the dependsOn pair pasteMultipleSkusForGuestUserVerifyQuickOrderPadNavigation -> pasteMultipleSkusForGuestUserVerifyNotSelectingProductFromSuggestionListValidationMessage (disabled, enabled = false): first method captures; the disabled consumer types maxQuantityProduct.sku without selecting the suggestion and has no needs.

validSku z-2460001 (quickOrderPage!C11): active SimpleProduct 'Black + Decker 6.5 in Corded Angle Grinder', OutOfStockOptions DontTrackInventory, MinimumQuantity 1 / MaximumQuantity 100 (tda rows). The Playwright profile (2026-11-01) saw storefrontProductIndex 0; bin/tda readiness (2026-11-05) reports that the record now qualifies for these needs. Inventory 25 per warehouse row (tda rows dbo.ZnodeInventory). Preferred, not required.

Range message 'Selected quantity should be in between 1 to 100': 1 is the product's MinimumQuantity, 100 its MaximumQuantity (z-2460001: Min 1 / Max 100). Need = the Playwright maxQuantityProduct pattern: PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK {quantityUsed 1, minMaxQuantity 1, outOfStockOption DontTrackInventory (so a stock check cannot pre-empt the range message), maxPersonalizableAttributes 0 (Quick Order rejects personalizable products)}. Outputs used: sku, minQuantity, maxQuantity. The message stays expected-output; the migrated test builds it from minQuantity/maxQuantity.

aboveMaximumQuantity 101 (quickOrderPage!C15) is config (a quantity the test chooses); it equals MaximumQuantity + 1 for the sheet product, so the migrated test types maxQuantityProduct.maxQuantity + 1.

Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware), the same store as the Selenium shoppingCart entries and the Playwright quick-order entries.

Profile: work/profiles/profile.json (2026-11-01) was not run for these Selenium tests (profiled false); product facts come from bin/tda rows dbo.ZnodePimProduct (2026-11-05) and the approved Playwright quick-order entries.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, delays) are framework constants: role config, no need.
migrate: Selenium reads Excel tables through TestData.getMap; there is no swap for Selenium.
